notes.title: Pixels are blooming, discounts are singing - Steam Spring Sale is here!
notes.notes:
What a beautiful day outside! On a day like this, folks like us should be playing some games! Today marks the start of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Hyperstrange/sale/HyperSale]Steam Spring Sale[/url] and Hyperstrange has prepared some hyper-entertainment and hyper-discounts for you!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Hyperstrange/sale/HyperSale][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/323fc7fd91ca09466ad025d2146789fc4c714e4a.png[/img][/url]

[h1]New bundles galore![/h1]

Bundles, you know 'em, you love 'em. Some of them have already stolen your hearts and if not, maybe these ones will:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28819/The_Good_The_Bad_and_The_Low_Poly/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/31157/Git_Gud_at_FPS_games_with_RAYZE__KovaaKs/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/30877/Ancient_Defenders/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/30993/Warlords__Generals_vol_4/

Many more great deals to discover in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Hyperstrange/sale/HyperSale]our sale page[/url]!

[h1]Upcoming games[/h1]

If you are hungering for more '90s FPS shooters and feeling nostalgic for beautiful stylized pixels, then look no further, for GHOSTWARE: Arena of the Dead and Supplice will just hit the spot. Add them to your wishlist so that you don't miss them as they are right around the corner:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1893370/GHOSTWARE_Arena_of_the_Dead/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1693280/Supplice/
